earnings.title: FOR: EMCOR GROUP, INC.
highlights: Operating Income of $545.8 million and Operating Margin of 9.8%
Non-GAAP Operating Income of $579.8 million and Non-GAAP Operating Margin of 10.5%
Non-GAAP Diluted EPS of $9.60, 46.1% Increase Year-over-Year

items.heading: Economic downturns, recessions, or periods of slow growth have historically led to reductions in demand for our services. Negative conditions in the credit markets, including elevated interest rates, may adversely impact our results of operations and our ability to operate our business.
Certain of our businesses, including those within our United States industrial services segment, are exposed to risks associated with the oil and gas industry.
Our business is vulnerable to the cyclical nature of the sectors in which our clients operate and is dependent upon the timing and funding of new awards.

Volatility in the prices or availability of certain materials, equipment, and commodities used in our businesses and those of our customers, including as a result of inflation, supply chain disruptions, geopolitical instability, and protectionist trade measures, could adversely affect our businesses.
The loss of customers could have an adverse effect on us.
We are a decentralized company which presents certain risks.
